source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Joshua 9–17 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 256 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Retains the marriage promise as Caleb’s act without adding consent or motives absent from this verse.
Preserves the kinship phrase’s possible attachments with a note instead of silently deciding the relationship.
Keeps Achsah as the initiator, the husband as one urged to ask, and the move to her direct request.
Preserves blessing language, the Negev and both sets of water sources without paraphrasing her request away.
Retains both the full name list and stated twenty-nine despite their numerical tension, explained in a note.
Keeps both Gederah forms and stated fourteen without deleting an entry to force agreement.
Follows qere Great Sea, notes written boundary form, and retains both cities and coastal reach.
Follows the Hebrew reading tradition Janum while documenting the written Janim.
Preserves inability and enduring co-residence, keeping allotment distinct from actual possession.
